composition.title: The Hypostasis of the Archons — Sophia, Veil, Rulers, Adam, Norea, Eleleth, and the Root Above

scenes.title: The arrogant ruler mistakes a local realm for the entirety
A formed human exceeds the makers
Norea refuses the ancestry of possession
Eleleth: rescue and the rulers' own origin
The root disclosed; the ending still to come

expression:return-of-zero:roz-mytheme-my.title: Samael / Yaldabaoth — the blind chief ruler
"you are mistaken, Samael" — the voice from incorruptibility
his field's edge — no visible superior inside it
Adam — formed after a perceived image; life exceeding their authority
spirit descending from the Adamantine Land
the spiritual woman — awakening Adam; escaping pursuit as a tree
the shadow — violated; materially necessary to Norea's later denial
the garden's prohibition; sleep becoming ignorance; expulsion and toil
Norea — daughter of Eve; refusing the imposed descent
the rulers' claim — authority through Eve; coercion attempted
her cry to the higher divine reality
the ark refused, breathed aflame — her relation to the flood set against Noah's
Eleleth — golden appearance, snowy clothing; rescue and disclosure
Pistis Sophia — desiring to create without her consort; the veil between worlds
shadow → matter → the lion-faced ruler — the second horizon-mistake
seven offspring and the layered heavens; Sabaoth in the seventh below the veil
Zoe's rebuke; Yaldabaoth bound in Tartaros; Sabaoth's throne and Zoe teaching at his right
the root above — Norea's origin exceeding the rulers' universe
the promised disclosure after three generations — the immediate rescue is not the completion
the closing hymn — the collective voice before Father, Son and Holy Spirit
A20 retrieval route — image and claimed authority through coercion, refusal and revelation (human-amplified: no for the technical reading)
